demos.name: Observability Lab
demos.description: Follow a log line from PingOne, PingFederate and Ping Gateway to a searchable, alertable store, with Privilege sensor and MCP gateway lines too. Seeded mock logs, a query box, three alert rules and a label lab that shows the silent failure of a missing relabel rule. Real reads one loopback Loki.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7800). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7800 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Real: start the lab's own stack (OBS_LOKI_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 docker compose --profile stack up -d), or set OBS_LOKI_URL to your own loopback Loki. The Privilege SIEM, Kibana links and agent-gateway log volume are bring-your-own. A small standalone monitoring stack (Alloy, Loki); line shapes are illustrative and labelled UNVERIFIED. Catalog id D123.
